# Ascent GEO

> Ascent GEO is the GEO/LLMO site for Ascent Networks. It explains how the brand is discovered and cited in AI search, with service pages, framework guidance, and research articles.

Use the core pages for product and service context, the lab articles for research, and the sitemap for a complete index of public pages.
